name: Six Senses Qing Cheng Mountain
insider_take: Nestled at the foot of sacred Qing Cheng Mountain, this wellness sanctuary seamlessly blends ancient Taoist wisdom with Six Senses' signature sustainable luxury.
whats_special: This is the only international luxury resort located within the UNESCO World Heritage buffer zone of Mount Qingcheng, one of Taoism's most sacred birthplaces. The property features traditional Sichuan architecture with modern eco-conscious design, including an Earth Spa that incorporates traditional Chinese medicine and a rooftop garden growing organic herbs used in treatments.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise Tai Chi session on the mountain trail - it's led by a local Taoist master and offers exclusive access to ancient temples before they open to the public.
dont_miss: The cable car journey to Shangqing Palace temple (1,600 years old) and the hotel's signature "Panda Conservation Experience" at nearby Dujiangyan Panda Base, where you can participate in behind-the-scenes conservation efforts just 30 minutes away.
pros: Stunning mountain location at the base of sacred Qing Cheng Mountain
Exceptional wellness facilities including spa treatments and meditation programs
Sustainable luxury design integrated with natural surroundings
Access to UNESCO World Heritage site and Taoist cultural experiences
cons: Remote mountain location requiring longer transfer times
Limited dining options in immediate vicinity outside the resort
